text:
alex: Hey — customer reported sudden SSO failures after IdP cert rotation. Intermittent 403 on our ACS, only for some users, looks tied to RelayState. Posting logs and repro steps.

maria: Which customer / tenant? Are they on multi-IdP config? any recent metadata fetches?

alex: tenant: corp-acme (private deploy). They have primary+backup IdP entries. We rotated signing certs yesterday from the IdP side. We got an automated metadata refresh at 09:12UTC and then a bunch of 403s starting 09:18UTC.

support-bot: alert: auth-service detected 27 SAML validation failures in last 10m for tenant corp-acme (rule: saml-recipient-check)

jamal: Uploading a failing auth request curl output:

```
$ curl -v -X POST https://redwood.example.com/sso/acs/corp-acme -d @saml-response.xml
> HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
> Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "saml_recipient_mismatch",
  "detail": "Assertion Recipient 'https://idp.example.net/acs' does not match SP ACS 'https://redwood.example.com/sso/acs/corp-acme'"
}
```

jamal: And here is the SAML Response <saml:AuthnResponse> snippet (sanitized):

```
<saml:Conditions>
  <!-- omitted -->
</saml:Conditions>
<saml:SubjectConfirmation Method="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:cm:bearer">
  <saml:SubjectConfirmationData Recipient="https://idp.example.net/acs" NotOnOrAfter="2026-01-12T09:20:00Z"/>
</saml:SubjectConfirmation>
```

maria: aha — Recipient points to IdP ACS (idp.example.net) not our SP ACS. That explains recipient mismatch. Why would IdP send its own ACS as Recipient? Could be metadata mixup or a proxy/responder rewriting RelayState/Recipient.

alex: Looking at the IdP metadata we fetched: (trimmed)

```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.example.net">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="POST" Location="https://idp.example.net/acs" index="0"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
  <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
    <KeyInfo>...old-key...</KeyInfo>
  </KeyDescriptor>
  <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
    <KeyInfo>...new-key...</KeyInfo>
  </KeyDescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

alex: They have an SPSSODescriptor block in their metadata (they are also SP->IdP in some flows). Our metadata fetcher stored the first ACS it saw as the default reply-to, but their primary cert key order changed during rotation. We may have cached the wrong ACS for a short window.

infra-oncall: Quick check — cache TTL for idp metadata for private deploys is 5m (but we also have a sticky mapping keyed by entityID+first-acs). If metadata order changes, we'd keep the cached primary ACS until next refresh.

maria: Possible race: IdP rotated certs, published new metadata with ACS re-ordered. Our refresh picked up mixed state (old metadata in cache + new response in assertion) causing some auths to be constructed with wrong Recipient. Could also be RelayState being proxied. Any proxy logs?

jamal: Proxy (idp-proxy-01) logs show POST to IdP metadata endpoint at 09:12 with 200, then another at 09:13 with 200. The responses differ: first had ACS list [https://idp.example.net/acs, https://redwood.example.com/sso/acs/corp-acme], second had the redwood ACS first. So ordering flipped.

alex: Repro steps I used:
1) curl metadata endpoint -> save metadata.xml
2) run our metadata parser shim (`/bin/redwood-metadata-parse metadata.xml`) -> outputs default ACS
3) send SAML AuthnRequest using old default ACS in SubjectConfirmationData -> IdP returns Assertion with Recipient equal to whatever it expects.

maria: Short-term mitigation: flush metadata cache for corp-acme and force immediate re-fetch + set canonical ACS to our SP ACS based on tenant config rather than first-ACS-in-metadata. Can we push that patch to private deploys without downtime?

infra-oncall: We can call the control-plane refresh endpoint for the private deploy: `POST /admin/tenants/corp-acme/metadata/refresh` — this will atomically replace cached metadata. Doing that now.

support-bot: action: metadata-refresh-request accepted (req id 8f3a), started fetch from idp.example.net

infra-oncall: Done. Cache replaced at 09:27UTC. Also applied temporary override to prefer ACS matching tenant SP config.

jamal: Retesting with the same failing payload -> now 200 OK, user successfully logged in. Thanks.

alex: Root cause writeup: IdP published metadata during cert rotation with different ACS ordering; our metadata ingestion logic treated the first ACS as the canonical Recipient for constructing SubjectConfirmationData. Mixed fetches across the rotation window left some assertions with the IdP's ACS as recipient, resulting in recipient mismatch and 403s. Fixed by preferring tenant-configured SP ACS and adding a short dedupe check when multiple ACS entries exist. Also lowered metadata cache jitter during rotations.

maria: Please file a support postmortem and add a test to the metadata parser for multi-ACS ordering flips. @jamal can you add the repro case as unit test?

jamal: Yep, I'll PR the parser test and the cache-preference fix. Linking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-9021

alex: Customer notified, they confirmed sessions are recovering. Marking resolved for now :white_check_mark:
